items.headline: China tightens export licensing for rare-earth magnets
items.summary: China's Ministry of Commerce said exports of sintered NdFeB magnets and of products shipped with such magnets as separate items will require end-use certificates. Industry sources expect processing times of four to eight weeks.

items.headline: Ganzhou magnet makers pause new export contracts pending guidance
items.summary: Several magnet producers in Ganzhou, Jiangxi, have paused shipments to export customers until the licensing procedure is clarified.
